brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir demanded the dissolution of the Palestinian Authority, the disarming of its forces, and the arrest of its members, the Maan Wire reported. Ben Gvir's statement represents a hardline position on Palestinian governance structures amid ongoing Israeli-Palestinian tensions.

The minister's call targets the institutional framework of the Palestinian Authority, which has functioned as the governing body for parts of the occupied Palestinian territories since its establishment in 1994.
title: Ben Gvir calls for dismantling Palestinian Authority and disarming it
